Open source · Native macOS · Markdown-first

Built for thinking

Your notes,
without the noise.

Obby is a native macOS notes app built around normal files. Write notes, organise folders, search your work and ask AI questions — without plugin mazes or proprietary formats.

.md

Normal files

Ordinary Markdown files. Normal folders and attachments. A workspace you already know how to use.

⌘

AI that can act

Search, organise and edit notes through controlled tools, when you ask. More than a conversation beside your work.

↔

Your model

Run a local model through Ollama or connect a supported provider. The choice stays with you.

02 / At home on macOS

Room for your thoughts.

A native app.
Just the things you need.

A quieter workspace

Not another
AI sidebar.

Obby’s assistant works with your actual notes through a controlled tool layer. Find a thought, read the relevant notes, create a new one, or ask for an edit.

01Find and read the notes that matter.

02Create, edit and organise when asked.

03Read supported attachments, including PDFs.

File actions stay inside your notes folder. Deletion always asks for confirmation. Available actions depend on your model’s capabilities.
05 / Yours, all the way down

Delete Obby.
Keep your notes.

Your notes folder is the source of truth. Obby doesn’t lock your writing inside a proprietary database.

Open your files in Finder, Obsidian, VS Code or any Markdown editor. They’re still yours when Obby is gone.

An ordinary folder on your Mac
Obby/
├── School/
│   └── Biology/
│       ├── Enzymes.md
│       └── Revision.md
├── Projects/
└── Attachments/
No export required. No way out needed.
